statement: The Ed25519 public key named below is the publication key InferRoute uses to sign the reference file that its sealed-search certificates are checked against. A reference signed by any other key is not ours, whatever it claims. This document is signed by a verified identity and recorded in a public append-only transparency log so that the binding can be checked by anyone, at any time, without asking InferRoute for anything.
note_on_scope: This attests WHICH key is ours. It does not assert that any particular record is genuine, nor what the sealed software did with a text after decrypting it. Those are separate questions and no signature answers them.
